description: Front porch: Single storey rear extension; Alterations to roof to form end gables and rear dormer; Roof lights in front roof slope and window in gable end; External alterations (Demolition of front dormers and rear conservatory)
decision_conditions: <p style="margin-bottom:0cm; padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif"><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="line-height:normal">The proposed single-storey rear extension, by virtue of its excessive depth, scale and massing, would constitute a disproportionate and overly dominant addition that fails to respect the form, proportions and character of the host dwelling. The proposal would therefore result in a form of development that is out of keeping with the prevailing pattern of development within the surrounding area. As such, the proposal would result in unacceptable harm to local character and visual amenity, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021–2041), and the Council’s Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></span></span></p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt; text-align:justify"><br></p>

<p><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; text-align: justify;">The proposed rear dormer, by reason of its excessive scale, bulk, and visually dominant form, would appear as an incongruous and overbearing addition that fails to preserve nor enhance the West Drive Conservation Area and the established roofscape of the host dwelling and surrounding area. As such, the proposal would result in unacceptable harm to local character and visual amenity, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021–2041), and the Council’s Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></p>
